stem.text: The diagrams show the diffraction of water waves in a ripple tank as they pass through a gap between two barriers.

A.alt: Ripple tank diagram: straight wavefronts travelling right towards two grey barriers with a gap between them, and curved wavefronts drawn beyond the gap.
